biggest_catch: Only healthy males and females aged 19-50 who pass screening qualify; you must stay overnight in the Celerion clinic in Lincoln, NE on Oct 4, Oct 8, and Oct 11, 2026, and the 'up to $3,250' stipend is paid only for completing all required stays and the return visit.
catches: Must be a healthy male or female aged 19-50, BMI 18-32, and pass medical screening and doctor exam; not everyone qualifies

Tests an investigational medication for emergency allergic reactions and anaphylaxis given by intramuscular injection and nasal administration, with 38 blood draws; medical risks disclosed in the informed consent form
Time commitment: screening (~2-3 hours) plus three 1-night clinic stays (check-ins Oct 4, Oct 8, Oct 11, 2026) and one return visit on Oct 15, 2026
Location-specific: Lincoln, Nebraska clinic only - must be able to attend in person
Stipend 'may pay up to reflected amount' - the full $3,250 is conditional on completing the study; early withdrawal or disqualification reduces payment
